description: Finish Gate B delivery and prepare optional Gate C after FEAT-001 through FEAT-004: implement CPU-verifiable QLoRA/Lightning orchestration without running a GPU, build the deterministic transfer bundle, add security/CI/docs, and derive final independent gate statuses from execution evidence.
steps: Implement configs/qlora.yaml, training/train_qlora.py, evaluate_adapter.py, export_adapter.py, merge_adapter.py, src/acharya/lightning.py, and scripts/lightning_a100.sh for the locked Qwen revision, NF4/bf16 LoRA profile, CPU preflight/five-step dry-run, real external 100-optimizer-step smoke/profile, 10-credit and 240-minute quote/projection abort caps, bounded stages, checkpoints/resume, held-out/adversarial evaluation, atomic adapter/optional merge hashes, and PEFT-backed RAG smoke.

Run only CPU/tiny-local-model/fake-runner verification in this sandbox; record no compatible GPU and leave Gate C PENDING_EXTERNAL_GPU. Document why full AdamW exceeds one A100 40 GB and why QLoRA is the selected reversible profile.

Implement scripts/prepare_handoff.sh and bundle tests to create deterministic sorted/fixed-mtime zstd output from tracked source/config/lock/tests plus finalized processed/SFT/reports, with complete manifest and copy/upload/raw inventories but no credentials, raw archives by default, unclear-rights data, model/index weights, adapters, or checkpoints.
Add full-history Gitleaks 8.24.2 CI, frozen uv install, Ruff/mypy/pytest, Linux iOS structural validation, and comprehensive README commands/gate semantics/licensing/provider/bundle/GPU guidance.

Run scripts/verify_all.sh, actual available data/index/API/provider/bundle checks, clean extraction, full-history secret scan, and git status; write Gate A/B/C reports strictly from evidence, keeping external acquisition/macOS/provider blockers and optional GPU status explicit.
acceptance_criteria: The Lightning workflow validates quote, A100 >=39 GiB, CUDA/RAM/disk/storage/auto-stop and bundle hashes before model load; stage markers are input-hash-bound, resume selects only a valid checkpoint, and failure never becomes COMPLETED.

The local CPU preflight/dry-run and fake 100-step orchestration pass without starting paid training, and Gate C remains PENDING_EXTERNAL_GPU until real checkpoint/adapter/evaluation/serving artifacts exist.

A successful external run could be marked COMPLETED only with checkpoint state, adapter_config.json, adapter_model.safetensors, tokenizer/base revision, run/file hashes, held-out/adversarial/safety report, and PEFT RAG consumption evidence; no quality gain is claimed otherwise.

Two Gate B bundles from the same completed preparation have identical hashes, validate from clean extraction, include required source/finalized data/reports/inventories/bootstrap, and exclude secrets/raw/unclear-rights/model/adapter/checkpoint artifacts.
CI fetches full history and runs pinned redacted Gitleaks, frozen Python checks, offline backend tests, and Linux project validation without external/GPU assumptions.
Final reports show Gate A, Gate B, and Gate C separately; Gate B never borrows Gate A fallback as evidence for missing Kaggle/full/iOS/bundle work, and Gate C never blocks A/B.

findings: Implemented the locked Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct QLoRA profile at revision a09a35458c702b33eeacc393d103063234e8bc28 with all four safetensor SHA-256 values, NF4 double quantization/bf16/rank-16/1536-token/effective-batch-16 settings, lazy external training/evaluation/export/optional-merge/PEFT-RAG scripts, and one-A100 orchestration. External preflight validates one A100 >=39 GiB, strict preparation and bundle hashes, persistent storage, auto-stop, disk, real quote conversion, 10-credit/240-minute projections, and bounded stage ceilings before model loading. Stage markers are command/file/environment/hardware-input-hash-bound, failures remain FAILED, and checkpoint resume accepts only matching RUN_INPUT/global-step evidence. CPU verification ran the exact five-step no-save dry-run and fake 100-step runner; no NVIDIA runtime was present, paid_training_started/checkpoint_claimed/quality_gain_claimed are false, and Gate C remains PENDING_EXTERNAL_GPU. Added deterministic fixed-mtime/numeric-owner tar+zstd bundling, clean-extraction validation, inventories/bootstrap, and strict exclusions. Bundle fixture builds were byte-identical and validated, but no real transfer archive or archive hash was produced: two real strict preparation attempts remained BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_DATA for gpreda/medquad/1, akashkumarpr/ayurvedic-knowledge-dataset/1, and aliainaanraza/ayurveda-healthcare-dataset/2 because Kaggle authentication was unavailable and no hash-valid cache existed; packaging the PDF fallback would violate the strict-bundle rule. Final bundle evidence is therefore transfer_bundle.status=BLOCKED_STRICT_PREPARATION with bundles=[] rather than a fabricated success. Added frozen offline CI, pinned configured Gitleaks 8.24.2 full-history scanning, Linux iOS validation, verify_all orchestration, and comprehensive operator/gate/resource/licensing documentation. Verification: shell syntax, frozen retrieval+training install, Ruff, strict mypy (33 source files), 59 non-external tests, 7 focused FEAT-005 tests, Gate A network-denied restart, Linux Xcode structural validation, CPU preflight, live strict acquisition attempts, and configured full-history Gitleaks all passed as locally applicable. Provider check again exited transport 0 but returned response_mismatch, so it remains UNVERIFIED; macOS remains PENDING_MACOS_VALIDATION. Final independent evidence: Gate A PASSED report SHA-256 2c16976ff4446142991ad95c05f7d7f809ea76a9aaffb59d4f40c9f45883b100; Gate B BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_DATA report SHA-256 3b6a27769c1b9e4c5b9e848f4febbcfd6b1b33984a767feb4e750c5915a18221; Gate C PENDING_EXTERNAL_GPU report SHA-256 936124c3b43f9059f52cbd59656f856e87bd9a6ced80d546368c523ae9715ef1; final summary SHA-256 e4b6fadeecbfbfd01252d43f062216bcc8f0ea1c1692704a566af7bca05434be; provider record SHA-256 377c9d7f02826149f12aa00ba54e20ca0118a0bba760532da84a1c5885a5b5a5.
